say:1:1030203901:0.text: Sir, it's an honor to speak to you.
say:1:1030203901:0.source_cn: 外面来的大人，很荣幸能与您讲话。
say:1:1030203901:0.male: Sir, it's an honor to speak to you.
say:1:1030203901:0.female: My lady, it's an honor to speak to you.

say:2:1030203902:0.text: Rumors about the grape fields in Southville are spreading. We're all very curious.
say:2:1030203902:0.source_cn: 近期关于南村葡萄田的传闻到处都是，大家都对田地充满了好奇。
say:2:1030203902:0.male: Rumors about the grape fields in Southville are spreading. We're all very curious.
say:2:1030203902:0.female: Rumors about the grape fields in Southville are spreading. We're all very curious.

say:3:1030203903:0.text: I don't care much about it. No matter how much those grapes are worth, they're still grapes.
say:3:1030203903:0.source_cn: 对我来说倒没什么大不了的，那葡萄再值钱也是葡萄，还能是...
say:3:1030203903:0.male: I don't care much about it. No matter how much those grapes are worth, they're still grapes.
say:3:1030203903:0.female: I don't care much about it. No matter how much those grapes are worth, they're still grapes.

say:4:1030203904:0.text: However, the loud cries of gruglin are often heard near the grape fields...
say:4:1030203904:0.source_cn: 不过……葡萄田附近经常传来咕布林的叫声，粗鲁又嘹亮。
say:4:1030203904:0.male: However, the loud cries of gruglin are often heard near the grape fields...
say:4:1030203904:0.female: However, the loud cries of gruglin are often heard near the grape fields...

say:5:1030203905:0.text: I hope they won't enter our village. I need to keep a close eye on my child.
say:5:1030203905:0.source_cn: 希望它们不会到村里来，我必须看住我的孩子才行。
say:5:1030203905:0.male: I hope they won't enter our village. I need to keep a close eye on my child.
say:5:1030203905:0.female: I hope they won't enter our village. I need to keep a close eye on my child.
